meaning: Independent article-content scores, not calibrated probabilities, target relevance or event truth. Denied, speculative and historical reporting still contains its topic; extraction qualifies it before routing.

labels.emotion: Reporting contains expressed feelings, emotional reactions, sentiment or fan mood, including attributed, denied or historical feelings. Routine facts alone are not emotion.
labels.player_moves: Reporting discusses a player joining, leaving, being traded, loaned or recruited by a team, including transfer rumours or denials.
labels.availability: Reporting discusses injury, illness, recovery, fitness, medical assessment, suspension or disciplinary eligibility affecting participation.
labels.performance: Reporting describes player or team sporting performance, statistics, form, contributions, playing roles or tactical adjustments. A fixture schedule alone is not performance evidence.
labels.contracts: Reporting discusses employment contracts, extensions, renewals, salary, wages, release clauses or contract expiry.
labels.staffing: Reporting discusses coaches, managers, executives or ownership making personnel or leadership decisions, appointments, dismissals or organizational changes. A coach merely supplying a quote is not sufficient.
labels.competition: Reporting discusses match events or results, fixtures, opponents, standings, draws, qualification, tournaments or competition rules. Routine ticket-office logistics alone are not competition reporting.
labels.club_context: Reporting discusses substantive club or athlete developments outside playing performance: off-field conduct, finances, governance, facilities, community issues, identity or rivalries. Routine opening hours, ads and ticket collection instructions alone are not substantive developments.

routing_limits: Candidate evidence only. Insider needs a supported move/denial; standalone contracts and staffing may only serve Journalist. Scout needs an explicit selected kind, measured profile and applied source-linked roster/availability records when applicable. Analyst and Oracle consume finished cards; Graph independently reviews source names and result lines.
